name: astra-s3-vs-c6-devkit
comment: DUT = Astra custom ESP32-S3R8 board (chip antenna). Reference = ESP32-C6-DevKitC-1. No real network credentials are needed: the reference board creates its own SoftAP.
run_notes: Measured with ESP-IDF v5.5.4 and the iperf example's own sdkconfig.defaults.esp32s3 (the 'iperf rank' buffers). Espressif's published reference figures were measured on IDF commit 15575346 (2021-04-21) for ESP32/S2/S3/C3 and 7ff0a07d (2024-12-14) for ESP32-C6 - so they are a reference, not a spec for this build.

Reference is an ESP32-C6-DevKitC-1 (devkit antenna, different chip) while the DUT uses a small chip antenna on a compact board, so the scan/RSSI-delta verdict is INDICATIVE only. A conclusive antenna verdict needs an identical DUT board as the reference.
rssi_delta_db_max is relaxed to 20 dB here for that mixed-antenna comparison; the strict default in config/thresholds.json is 8 dB.
Official air/shield columns in the report are Espressif's best-case figures (shield-box needs a shielded box + router peer). They are reference only and never affect PASS/FAIL.
